AFWD.justification: The transformation of the discrete counting problem into a continuous integral over the unit circle

FFUSE.justification: The recombination of the major and minor arc contributions into a single total integral

IFIX.justification: The permanent upper bound on the minor arc magnitude that cannot be exceeded

steps.domain_action: Define the additive problem for a set of integers
Construct the exponential sum generating function
Map the discrete sum to an integral over the unit circle
Dissect the circle into major and minor arc subsets
Evaluate the major arcs using the singular series
Compose the local densities into a global product
Treat the minor arcs as a non-Hermitian dissipative operator
Apply the dissipative decay constant to the error term
Hold the transition region in a state of dual-classification
Recombine the major and minor arc integrals
Fix the error bound using the dissipative spectral radius
Output the final asymptotic count of solutions
